description.value: SURA Korean Grillhouse is a fully licensed Korean BBQ restaurant on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria, offering table-side grilling with an authentic Korean barbecue menu. The restaurant is open seven days a week for lunch and dinner and operates its own online delivery ordering. It is a solid mid-ride meal stop in the heart of the city.
